newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utils says Comanche 2 on line Wed.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utils says Comanche 2 on line Wed.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co expects its 1,150 megawatt (MW) Comanche peak nuclear power unit 2 to synchronize to the grid Wednesday following repairs, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
The unit was shut Saturday to repair a main feedwater valve.
The nearby Comanche Peak unit 1, with the same generating capacity, was unaffected by the outage and is operating at full power.
The Comanche Peak units in Glen Rose, Texas, produce about 18 percent of the company's electricity deliveries.
